title: The people of Beth-Shemesh are punished for looking into the ark
description: The Lord strikes down seventy men in Beth-Shemesh because they looked into the Lord's ark. The people mourn and ask who can stand before the holy God, and send word to Kiriath-Jearim to bring back the ark. [ref:1 Sam 6:19-21|1 Samuel 6:19-21]
